Prayer wall

A wall covered in prayer and hope

Leave a prayer request, or a word of hope for someone who needs it. Our intercession team prays over every request, every week.

Post on the wall

I would like to post

600 characters left

Demo: nothing is actually sent. In production, a Cloudflare Pages Function receives this form.

Thank you. Your message is in good hands.

The team will read it before it appears on the wall. Starting this week, our intercession team will be praying for you.

Every message is read by the team before it appears. We remove anything that could identify a person (last name, address, school…). Very personal requests can stay private: they will be carried in prayer without being published.

Sample — to confirm Messages shown as samples.

Seigneur, je te confie les enfants qui iront à l’école demain le ventre vide. Que quelqu’un les voie, et les nourrisse.

Message of hope

To whoever is reading this on a hard night: you are not forgotten. Morning comes. I’m praying for you right now.

Prayer request

Pour ma mère, veuve depuis cet été. Qu’elle retrouve la joie, et le goût de chanter le dimanche.

— Anonymous · Nov 6

Message of hope

« YHWH est près de ceux qui ont le cœur brisé. » Il a été près de moi l’hiver dernier. Il sera près de vous.

— Paul · Nov 5

Prayer request

Please pray for my brother, who is sleeping outside this week. That he would accept a bed — and that he’d call me.

— Grace · Nov 4

Message of hope

Merci aux bénévoles de jeudi soir. Votre soupe m’a réchauffé, mais c’est votre sourire qui m’a fait revenir.

— Anonymous · Nov 3

Prayer request

For the volunteers who go out on cold nights: strength in their legs and gentleness in their words.

— Jonathan · Nov 1

Prayer request

Pour les orphelins que nous ne connaîtrons jamais : Elohim, toi, tu connais leurs prénoms.

Message of hope
